biotools.summary: Napari NuclePhaser is a YOLO-based framework for cell nuclei detection and counting in phase contrast images, enabling cell counting and tracking without staining. It integrates with the Napari GUI and provides training-free calibration and testing for specific use cases.
biotools.name: Napari NuclePhaser
